text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... My skin seems rather irritated. 
Presumably due to the experiment.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I thought I was reasonably careful with 
handling the chemicals, though.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's just in a rough state; there's no 
harm in it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you didn't even notice, it probably 
wasn't a big deal.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Think nothing of it. If it gets worse, 
I'll just formulate an ointment for it."

"Though told to ignore it, Agnes Tachyon 
seemed slightly bothered by a faint pain 
or itch..."
